title: Senior ML Engineer — Ranking & Retrieval
description: Own training and evaluation pipelines for dense retrieval models that power vacancy–resume matching. You will work with product and research to ship offline metrics (nDCG, MRR) and safe online experiments. Strong focus on reproducible notebooks, feature stores for text pairs, and latency budgets for real-time inference behind existing FastAPI embedding services.
skillsRequired: Python, PyTorch, transformers, FAISS or Milvus, MLflow or similar experiment tracking, SQL

title: NLP Engineer — LLM Guardrails & Prompting
description: Design prompt templates and evaluation harnesses for domain-specific assistants used by recruiters. Implement refusal policies, PII redaction checks, and regression suites over golden transcripts. Collaborate with backend engineers on token budgets and streaming UX for long vacancy descriptions.
skillsRequired: Python, OpenAI or open-weight LLM APIs, pytest, regex and NER basics, JSON schema

title: Staff Frontend Engineer (React + TypeScript)
description: Lead the job discovery surface: filters, saved searches, and accessibility for keyboard and screen-reader users. Drive performance budgets (LCP, CLS) and coordinate with design on component APIs. Mentor mid-level engineers on testing strategy with Vitest and Playwright smoke flows for critical paths.
skillsRequired: React, TypeScript, Next.js, TanStack Query, TailwindCSS, Web Vitals

title: Backend Engineer — Go microservices
description: Build idempotent ingestion adapters and rate-limited clients for external job providers. Own OpenAPI specs, structured logging, and graceful degradation when upstream APIs throttle. Experience with MongoDB transactions for upsert-heavy workloads and observability via RED metrics is essential.
skillsRequired: Go, gRPC, MongoDB, OpenAPI, Docker, GitHub Actions

title: Platform Engineer — Kubernetes & CI
description: Harden multi-environment deploys for the Next.js app and Python ML sidecar. Implement progressive delivery, secrets rotation patterns, and backup drills for MongoDB. Document runbooks for on-call and reduce flaky pipelines with test splitting and cache hygiene.
skillsRequired: Kubernetes, Helm, GitHub Actions, Terraform basics, Prometheus, Bash

title: Mobile Engineer — Flutter (iOS/Android)
description: Ship cross-platform apps for candidates: saved vacancies, push notifications for new matches, and offline-friendly job cards. Integrate secure auth flows and deep links from marketing campaigns. Collaborate with designers on motion and haptics without hurting battery life.
skillsRequired: Flutter, Dart, Firebase, REST, platform channels, CI for mobile

title: Data Engineer — Analytics & Search quality
description: Build dbt models and Airflow DAGs over clickstream and search logs to measure semantic retrieval quality. Partner with PMs on funnel dashboards and anomaly detection for embedding drift. Ensure PII minimization in pipelines feeding analytics and behaviour scoring features.
skillsRequired: SQL, dbt, Python, Airflow or Dagster, BigQuery or ClickHouse basics

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description: Improve SLOs for API gateways and embedding service dependencies. Run game days, define error budgets, and tune alerts to reduce noise. Champion tracing across Node and Python services so incidents are diagnosable within minutes during thesis demos and production traffic.
skillsRequired: SRE practices, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, load testing, incident response

title: Full-stack Engineer (Next.js + API design)
description: Own vertical slices from Postgres/Mongo persistence through React server components for employer dashboards. Implement RBAC-aware APIs and optimistic UI for vacancy edits. Participate in design reviews for semantic search panels and explainability copy surfaced to end users.
skillsRequired: Next.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, Zod, REST, accessibility

title: Application Security Engineer
description: Threat-model OAuth flows, session handling, and ingestion endpoints that accept structured job payloads. Run dependency scanning in CI and advise on secrets management for demo and production parity. Support responsible disclosure and lightweight pen-test fixes without blocking feature teams.
skillsRequired: OWASP ASVS, OAuth2, Node or Go stacks, SAST tools, threat modeling
